trailhead.label: The Passo del Giovo (1,706 m), by its fountain, the published start

cautions: Cattle graze the Valle Albano pastures in summer: keep your distance and your dog on a short lead.
Open ground at 1,700–1,830 m with no shade: storms and fog build fast on summer afternoons.
The road up to the Passo del Giovo is narrow and closed in winter or in ice and snow.
No water point is listed on this walk: carry enough for you and your dog.
Follow local signs, lead rules and temporary closures.

emergency.note: Call the European emergency number when urgent help is required. Connectivity is not guaranteed.
